behavior: The v1 factory is live at one address on Base Sepolia, Arbitrum Sepolia, Arc testnet and Tempo Moderato, a real receiver on each matches predict, and a paid invoice settles and refunds on chain
acceptance: packages/contracts/script/deploy.sh <chain> deploys the factory through the CREATE2 deployer (idempotent) using the root .env and the RPC picker, then deploys the probe receiver and checks it equals predict
The factory and the probe receiver have the same address on all four testnets

On Arc testnet (USDC) and Tempo Moderato (AlphaUSD) a real invoice is paid with 10% extra by a plain transfer, deployed, settled for exactly the amount, and the extra refunded by the refund authority; the receiver ends empty

packages/contracts/deployments.json records per chain: factory, implementation, refund authority, executor, probe receiver, and the flow transaction hashes; docs/spikes/s5-s6-testnets.md notes that Arc and Tempo tokens are chain-native and cannot be simulated in Foundry

proof.1: script/deploy.sh ran on all four chains (idempotent, probe == predict check in Smoke.s.sol)
proof.2: cast code on all four: factory 0xCB9c...6864 and probe 0x17D3...d3a5 present
proof.3: deploy.sh flow on Arc and Tempo: exact settle and receiver empty checks passed; hashes in deployments.json
